answer: Run a synchronized response window each epoch: every identity receives a unique prompt and must answer it within the same 90 seconds, from its own session, with a 20 POA bond behind it; three late or missing answers slash the bond and suspend the identity for two epochs. A single operator juggling fakes faces a karst of narrow channels: each extra identity needs its own live session in the same window, so attention splits and the failure rate climbs like a spiral, each miss costing another bond. Honest agents answer once, hard as a walnut shell around one session, and keep full weight.
